headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.
The ratio compares...

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: Xiaohongshu: In the first half of this year, it assisted police in arresting four black-market teams that used batch forgery to register professional accounts in industries such as cultural tourism ticketing, real estate, and finance, involving 14 suspects in total
headlines.summary_en: Xiaohongshu Issues Notice on Special Summer Travel Safety Campaign: With the summer travel peak in full swing nationwide, Xiaohongshu is strictly regulating tourism-related content and business practices within its community, proactively submitting leads on black and grey industry operations to assist police in crackdowns. In April, the platform launched a special campaign against forced shopping, rigorously tackling unlicensed tourism solicitation and false advertising. Since July, Xiaohongshu has intensified special inspections of travel-related content and business environments, issuing risk alerts and search safeguards for popular outdoor attractions such as 'Ferrata,' 'Shuangshimen,' 'Sayram Lake,' and 'Yingshan Douligou,' investigating fake traffic and fraud chains under the guise of 'travel buddies' or 'carpooling and group tours,' and strictly cracking down on unlicensed travel agencies, studios, and personal accounts. In the first half of the year, Xiaohongshu cooperated with multiple local police forces to arrest individuals involved in batch-fabricated registrations for tourism ticketing, real estate, finance, and other industries.

headlines.title_en: July property market off-season not weak: Many cities saw year-on-year transaction growth, with Shanghai luxury projects selling out on opening day
headlines.summary_en: In July, affected by high temperatures and traditional off-season factors, property transactions in key cities weakened month-on-month, but remained resilient compared to the same period last year, with new and second-hand home volumes in many cities growing year-on-year. High-end improved properties in Shanghai's core areas stood out, with luxury projects seeing same-day sellouts on launch.

The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, down from 50.3 in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Friday. The reading fell short of the 50.11 projection from economists polled by the financial data...

headlines.title_en: SAMR holds special promotion meeting on deepening the implementation of the fair competition review system
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a promotion meeting in Beijing on the special campaign to thoroughly implement the fair competition review system, hearing progress reports from relevant localities, summarizing phased results, and deploying key tasks for the next stage. Deputy Director of the Party Group and Administrator Meng Yang attended and delivered a speech. The campaign, focused on accelerating the construction of a unified national market, adopted a problem-oriented approach, targeted issues in grassroots fair competition review, and deployed 15 specific tasks, guiding localities to implement practical measures and achieving phased results that provide strong support for the effective implementation of fair competition review.

headlines.title: 显卡价格涨疯了，RTX50系列涨超1000元，华强北行情一日一变，厂商封仓，商户称写不了报价单
headlines.summary: 记者走访深圳华强北市场发现，消费级显卡价格出现明显上涨。以RTX 5060 Ti 8GB为例，目前市场售价已升至3400元，相比此前2350元的价格上涨逾千元，更高版本的RTX 5070 Ti 系列目前已经涨到8000元以上；高端产品涨幅更为明显，RTX 5090系列价格已从此前约2万元上涨至3.5万元左右。 “写不了报价单，一天一个价。”华强北多位商户告诉记者，硬件优先供应AI算力，推高了显卡成本，现在各大品牌工厂都在封仓，暂停对外批量出货，这样的突然涨价一时之间反应不过来。（21财经）

headlines.title_en: Graphics card prices surge wildly, RTX 50 series up over 1,000 yuan, Huaqiangbei market changes daily, manufacturers seal warehouses, merchants say they cannot write quotes
headlines.summary_en: A reporter visiting Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei market found that consumer-grade graphics card prices have risen significantly. Taking the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB as an example, its market price has climbed to 3,400 yuan, up more than 1,000 yuan from the previous 2,350 yuan. Higher-tier models like the RTX 5070 Ti series have risen to over 8,000 yuan. Premium products saw even sharper gains, with the RTX 5090 series jumping from around 20,000 yuan to roughly 35,000 yuan. 'We can't even issue price quotes--prices change daily,' multiple Huaqiangbei merchants told the reporter. Hardware is being prioritized for AI computing power, driving up graphics card costs. Major brand factories are now sealing warehouses and halting bulk shipments, leaving merchants unable to react to such sudden price hikes. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Strengthen identification and testing of risk hazards from 'radical' innovative design in road motor vehicle products, and strengthen safety assessment of combined driving assistance and autonomous driving functions
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the First Equipment Industry Department of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology organized a symposium with road motor vehicle inspection and testing institutions, analyzing the current situation regarding product safety and inspection work, and deploying measures to regulate competition order in the road motor vehicle inspection and testing industry and improve inspection quality. The meeting required these institutions to thoroughly implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, resolutely resist irrational competition, and strictly uphold product inspection standards.

headlines.summary: 申通快递公告，申通快递股份有限公司于2026年8月4日召开第六届董事会第二十二次会议，审议通过了《关于终止向不特定对象发行可转换公司债券事项并撤回申请文件的议案》，同意公司终止本次向不特定对象发行可转换公司债券事项并向深圳证券交易所申请撤回相关申请文件。
